title: Incremental SLO Attainment Visualizer and Priority Weigher
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Build a single, cross-team view that shows incremental SLO attainment (per-route and per-model) over rolling windows and surfaces a computed initiative priority score that converts SLI deltas and error-budget runway into actionable work candidates. Problem: teams currently rely on manual spreadsheets and ad-hoc dashboards to interpret error-budget consumption; this causes slow reaction, duplicated work, and misaligned prioritization across infra, runtime, and console teams. Goals: 1) show live SLO attainment, error-budget runway, and the top contributing routes or customer cohorts; 2) compute a configurable priority score that factors SLI delta, customer-facing impact, rollout risk, and cost delta; 3) integrate into Initiative Tracker so PMs can convert high-priority findings into scoped initiatives with recommended playbooks. Scope: backend aggregation pipeline (15m/1h/24h windows), a Priority Weigher API, and a Console visualization with drilldowns to traces and recent incidents. Out of scope for MVP: automatic project creation or automated rollbacks. Data inputs: per-route P99 latency, error rate, tokens-per-request, throughput, recent incident tags, customer tier mapping. Outputs: ranked list of candidate initiatives, recommended triage action (monitor, patch, canary), and acceptance criteria suggestions. Success metrics: reduction in mean time to mitigation for critical SLO burns by 30% in Q2; >70% of initiatives created from the visualizer adopted into planning cycles; PM/Eng NPS for incident prioritization improves by 1 point.
acceptance_criteria: Backend aggregates SLI signals for at least 95% of production routes on 3 windows (15m, 1h, 24h)
Priority Weigher API returns stable scores with documented formula and tunable weights via config
Console shows top 10 candidates with drilldown links to traces, recent errors, and related incidents
Automated export to Initiative Tracker creates a draft initiative with tags and suggested owners
Performance: dashboard load time < 800ms for summary view under normal load
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: noisy SLIs may surface false positives - Mitigation: add smoothing window + thresholding and allow manual dismissals
Risk: privacy/regulatory concerns for customer cohort data - Mitigation: only surface cohort-level IDs; require data access review for drilldowns
Risk: priority formula disagreement between teams - Mitigation: expose weights in config and ship ability to A/B different weight sets
implementation_notes: Backend: reuse existing SLI aggregator; add normalized cost signal (tokens * cost-per-token) and customer impact factor
API: ENpoints: GET /v1/priority-candidates?window=1h&limit=20; contract tracked in ENG-7841
Console: new 'SLO Attainment' panel under Reliability with heatmap and ranked list; design mock exists in Drive (DRIVE: SLO-Visualizer-RevA)
Telemetry: emit event when candidate converted to InitiativeTracker with tags for attribution
Rollout: opt-in beta for Platform and Payments teams before org-wide launch
